title: Longevypedia document frontmatter
description: Fields every Longevypedia Markdown document must declare in its YAML frontmatter, regardless of type. Type-specific schemas extend this one.

id.description: Stable identifier `<type>:<slug>`. Must match the directory and file name.

type.description: Document type. Determines the directory, the JSON Schema and the page template.

title.description: Human-readable title shown in the article header and in the catalog.

summary.description: One or two sentences that answer what this is. Used in cards, search results and meta description.

status.description: Publication status. Only `published` documents are visible on the public site.

locale.description: Language of the text. Must match the content directory the file lives in.

tags.description: Free-form keywords for search. Not curated; prefer topics for navigation.

aliases.description: Alternative names that resolve to this document: `[[Alias]]` and `[[slug|text]]` both work.

created.description: Date the document was first written (YYYY-MM-DD).

updated.description: Date of the last substantive edit (YYYY-MM-DD). Shown on the article page.

license.description: License of the prose. Defaults to CC-BY-SA-4.0; quoted excerpts keep their own terms.

review.description: Editorial review state. Separate from `status`: a published document can be unreviewed.

relations.description: Typed edges of the knowledge graph. Inverse edges are computed, never stored.

sources.description: Primary sources. Never invent a DOI or PMID: omit the field when the source does not provide one.

note.description: Why the edge exists. Required in practice for contradicting evidence.

citation.description: Full reference as it appears in the publication.
